input: A default worldview claim packages authority, ontology, and implication pressure into one carrier.

bridge_terms.D0: The surface claim behaves as a carrier rather than a single premise.
bridge_terms.PsiN: The encoded state preserves the packaged pressure set.
bridge_terms.selected_N: The selected frame supplies content, not a case template.
bridge_terms.expanded_IR: IR(N,m,tau,sigma,heart,xi,Omega,mu,kappa) derives the burden floor from live_registers(IR(...)).
bridge_terms.mu: The mu register is operative because it requires carrier decomposition before release.
bridge_terms.register_burden_floor: The burden floor contains a mu-typed burden whose operation exposes the carried registers.

control_effects.hold_release: Hold direct evidence release until the carrier is decomposed.
control_effects.burden_selection: Select a mu-typed carrier burden from live register state.
control_effects.reread: After Land(B1), reread each exposed carried pressure separately.

register_to_burden_obligation.derivation: burden_floor = {B_r : r in live_registers(IR(N,m,tau,sigma,heart,xi,Omega,mu,kappa))}; N supplies label content.

burden_floor.label: default-worldview carrier
burden_floor.register_operation: decompose the carrier by unpacking its packaging structure before evidence release
burden_floor.local_delta: Delta(B1): carrier package exposed and separated into carried pressures
burden_floor.land_contribution: Contribution-to-Land(B1): lands the decomposition so Omega, xi, and kappa routes can be worked individually

ir_projection.load_bearing_node: mu carrier decomposition controls burden selection and release order
ir_projection.what_is_withheld_and_why: Direct response is held until the carrier stops compressing the carried registers.

post_render_gate.remaining_live_distortions: carried registers may still need separate work
